newsitem.title: USA: Oil-Dri says Daniel Jaffee to become CEO.
newsitem.headline: Oil-Dri says Daniel Jaffee to become CEO.

text.p: Oil-Dri Corp of America said Tuesday that Daniel Jaffee, Oil-Dri's president and chief operating officer, will assume the additional responsibility of chief exective officer, effective August 1.
His father, Richard Jaffee, current chief executive officer, will remain with the company as board chairman and senior advisor, the company said.

In his new role as chief executive officer, Daniel Jaffee will focus on corporate strategy as well as the execution of the five-year growth plan recently adopted by the board of directors, the company said.
Oil-Dri shares were down 3/8 to 16-7/8 Tuesday.
